title: How to Make Money With Vibe Coding in 2026
summary: From niche SaaS subscriptions to freelance tool-building — 5 proven ways to monetize vibe coding in 2026. Real examples, real revenue models, honest failure rates.
body_markdown: For non-technical founders, Blink is the most complete starting point. It includes the database, auth, and hosting out of the box — free to start, no credit card required. You describe your app and it's live. That removes all the infrastructure decisions that usually slow first-time builders down. For selling templates and digital products, Gumroad and Lemon Squeezy handle payments and delivery with no technical setup required.
